text.en:
A new section is hereby inserted between sections four and five of Act Numbered Thirty-nine
hundred and ninety-seven, which shall be known as section four (A) and shall read as follows:
"Section 4(A). Transfer of duty to collect radio registration fees and application of Internal Revenue
Laws.-The duty pertaining to the collection of radio registration fees heretofore performed by the Radio
Registration Office created or designated under Act Numbered Thirty-eight hundred and forty-six shall be
performed by the Collector of Internal Revenue and the registration of radio receiving sets shall be made with
the said official. All special or general administrative provisions of law relative to assessment, remission,
collection, and refund of internal-revenue taxes, and consistent with the provisions of this Act, are made
extensive and applicable to the fees herein imposed."

- Section seven of Act Numbered Thirty-nine hundred and ninety-seven is hereby amended by
adding thereto a new subsection which shall read as follows:
"(e) Collection expenses.-Salaries of employees appointed by the Collector of Internal Revenue for the
collection of radio registration fees and necessary expenses incident to the registration of radio receiving sets
and the collection of fees due thereon."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 29, 1936.
